shared_elements: boat or long horizontal line with row of short vertical strokes (crew marks)
scattered motifs across an open field with no ground line
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive combination of highly schematic stick-like human figures, small profile quadrupeds and a long boat-like line topped with a row of short vertical crew strokes, all scattered over an open field without ground line or framing, in the same reductive silhouette/outline convention. The clearest difference is A's prominent repeated footprint (foot sole) motifs and grid sign, which have no counterpart in B, where large striding anthropomorphs with splayed limbs dominate.
